TableQuery: select c.table_schema as schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.ordinal_position as column_order, coalesce(c.character_maximum_length, 1) as max_length, coalesce(c.numeric_precision, 1) as precision, coalesce(c.numeric_scale, 0) as scale, (case when c.is_nullable = 'YES' then 1 else 0 end) as is_nullable, c.data_type as type_name from information_schema.columns as c join information_schema.tables as t on t.table_name = c.table_name and t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' order by c.table_catalog, c.table_schema, c.table_name, c.ordinal_position
ViewQuery: select c.table_schema as schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.ordinal_position as column_order, coalesce(c.character_maximum_length, 1) as max_length, coalesce(c.numeric_precision, 1) as precision, coalesce(c.numeric_scale, 0) as scale, (case when c.is_nullable = 'YES' then 1 else 0 end) as is_nullable, c.data_type as type_name from information_schema.columns as c join information_schema.tables as t on t.table_name = c.table_name and t.table_type = 'VIEW' order by c.table_catalog, c.table_schema, c.table_name, c.ordinal_position
ProcedureQuery: select r.routine_schema as schema_name, r.routine_name, p.parameter_name, p.ordinal_position as column_order, coalesce(p.character_maximum_length, 1) as max_length, coalesce(p.numeric_precision, 1) as precision, coalesce(p.numeric_scale, 0) as scale, p.parameter_mode, coalesce(p.data_type, p.user_defined_type_name) as type_name from information_schema.routines as r join information_schema.parameters as p on p.specific_name = r.routine_name where r.routine_type = 'PROCEDURE'
FunctionQuery: select r.routine_schema as schema_name, r.routine_name, p.parameter_name, p.ordinal_position as column_order, coalesce(p.character_maximum_length, 1) as max_length, coalesce(p.numeric_precision, 1) as precision, coalesce(p.numeric_scale, 0) as scale, p.parameter_mode, coalesce(p.data_type, p.user_defined_type_name) as type_name from information_schema.routines as r join information_schema.parameters as p on p.specific_name = r.routine_name where r.routine_type = 'FUNCTION'

SchemaQuery: select name [schema_name] from sys.schemas where principal_id = 1
TableQuery: select s.name [schema_name], t.name [table_name], c.name [column_name], c.column_id [column_order], c.max_length, c.[precision], c.scale, c.is_nullable, ty.name [type_name] from sys.schemas s join sys.tables t on t.schema_id = s.schema_id join sys.columns c on c.object_id = t.object_id join sys.types ty on ty.system_type_id = c.system_type_id and ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id where s.principal_id = 1 order by s.name, t.name, c.column_id
ViewQuery: select s.name [schema_name], v.name [table_name], c.name [column_name], c.column_id [column_order], c.max_length, c.[precision], c.scale, c.is_nullable, ty.name [type_name] from sys.schemas s join sys.views v on v.schema_id = s.schema_id join sys.columns c on c.object_id = v.object_id join sys.types ty on ty.system_type_id = c.system_type_id and ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id where s.principal_id = 1 order by s.name, v.name, c.column_id
ProcedureQuery: select s.name [schema_name], p.name [routine_name], par.name [parameter_name], par.parameter_id [parameter_order], par.max_length, par.[precision], par.scale, (case when par.is_output = 1 then 'INOUT' else 'IN' end) [parameter_mode], ty.name [type_name] from sys.procedures p join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = p.schema_id join sys.parameters par on par.object_id = p.object_id join sys.types ty on ty.system_type_id = par.system_type_id and ty.user_type_id = par.user_type_id
FunctionQuery: select s.name [schema_name], f.name [routine_name], par.name [parameter_name], par.parameter_id [parameter_order], par.max_length, par.[precision], par.scale, (case when par.is_output = 1 then 'INOUT' else 'IN' end) [parameter_mode], ty.name [type_name] from sys.objects f join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = f.schema_id join sys.parameters par on par.object_id = f.object_id join sys.types ty on ty.system_type_id = par.system_type_id and ty.user_type_id = par.user_type_id where f.type = 'IF'
